name: Reunionese Cabri Massalé
description: Cabri massalé, goat curry, is real Réunion's most representative Tamil dish, especially central to Tamil New Year celebrations - real technique dissolves tamarind into the cooking liquid and simmers the meat for a full hour or more with real massalé (garam masala) and turmeric, traditionally presented on a banana leaf and eaten by hand; ground lamb stands in here for goat.

ingredients_full.note: formed into chunks, standing in for goat

ingredients.note: formed into chunks, standing in for goat

steps_detailed: Brown the lamb, 8-9 minutes, then add the onion and cook 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger, cooking 2 minutes, then the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the garam masala and turmeric, and cook 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the vinegar and enough water to cover, and simmer at least 50-60 minutes - real cabri massalé depends on this long simmer for full flavor.

name: Reunionese Rougail Saucisse
description: Rougail saucisse, sausage in a real chili-tomato sauce, is genuinely Réunion's most iconic everyday dish, real technique crushing real chilies with salt in a mortar before mixing with the cari-créole spice blend.

ingredients_full.note: standing in for local sausage, sliced

ingredients.note: standing in for local sausage, sliced

steps_detailed: Crush the jalapeño with a pinch of salt.
Brown the sausage in a little oil, 6-7 minutes.
Add the onion, cumin, and turmeric, and cook 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and crushed jalapeño, and simmer 18-20 minutes until thickened.

name: Reunionese Bouillon Larson
description: Bouillon larson, a real spiced lentil sauce, is the traditional accompaniment to cabri massalé, real technique built on cumin, cloves, mustard, garlic, and ginger together.
steps_detailed: Cook the garlic and ginger in a little oil, 1-2 minutes.
Add the cumin, cloves, mustard, and turmeric, and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lentils and 1.5 cups water, and simmer 20-22 minutes until tender.

name: Reunionese Cari Poulet
description: Cari poulet, chicken curry, is the most common everyday cari in Réunion, real technique built on real onion, turmeric, chili, tomato, thyme, and garlic, finished with real massalé.
steps_detailed: Brown the chicken with the onion, 8-9 minutes.
Add the turmeric, jalapeño, tomatoes, thyme, and garlic, and simmer 20-22 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Stir in the garam masala in the last 5 minutes as a real finishing flourish.

name: Reunionese Rougail Tomate
description: Rougail tomate, a fresh, uncooked tomato relish, is a genuine keystone condiment across Réunion, real technique building balance from onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and a touch of chili - never overcooked.
steps_detailed: Mix everything together and let sit at least 10-15 minutes for the flavors to meld - real rougail is meant to stay fresh and bright, not cooked down.

name: Reunionese Brede Stir-fry
description: Brede, leafy greens stir-fried simply, is a common Réunion side dish, real technique keeping the seasoning minimal so the greens' own flavor carries the dish.
steps_detailed: Cook the garlic in the oil, 30 seconds.
Add the spinach and stir-fry 4-5 minutes until just wilted.

name: Reunionese Samoussas
description: Samoussas, fried triangular pastries reflecting Réunion's real Indian culinary influence, a beloved snack found across the island.
steps_detailed: Brown the beef with the onion and curry powder, 6-7 minutes.
Cut the phyllo into strips, fill, and fold into triangles.
Fry, turning, 3-4 minutes, until deeply golden.

name: Reunionese Grilled Fish
description: Grilled fish rubbed with garlic and lemon, reflecting Réunion's rich Indian Ocean fishing tradition.
steps_detailed: Rub the fish with the garlic and lemon juice, and let sit 10 minutes.
Grill or broil, 4-5 minutes per side, until just cooked through.
